ave_label_density_gt_150_kbp.description: Average number of labels per 100 kbp for the molecules that are 150kbp or longer, example value is 15.57 /100kbp

base_pairs_per_pixel.description: Calculated base pairs per pixel in the alignment by comparing molecules to the reference.

bnx_file.description: name and path of raw molecule file

map_rate.description: Percentage of molecules that are 150kbp or longer mapped to the reference

molecule_file_optical_mapping_id.description:
identifier for molecule_file_optical_mapping (primary key)

Notes: experiment_short_read_id + alignment indicator

n50_gt_150_kbp.description: N50 of DNA molecules that are 150kbp or longer (in kbp)

n50_gt_20_kbp.description: N50 of the molecules that are 20kbp or longer (in kbp)

negative_label_variance.description: Percentage of reference labels absent in molecules

positive_label_variance.description: Percentage of labels absent in reference

quality_issues.description: describe if there are any QC issues that would be important to note

relative_sd.description: Quadratic term in sizing error relative to reference

scaling_sd.description: Linear term in sizing error relative to reference

site_sd.description: Constant term in sizing error relative to reference
